scope: Every vector is a message sequence the package's parseServerMessage accepts, one message at a time (its verdict is recorded per vector). The conformance set keeps to guuey's id charset, its §6 bounds, and reference-complete trees: an id outside the charset, an over-bound value or a dangling child are guuey's refusals or degrades, pinned in validate.test.ts and fold.test.ts. The divergence vectors are guuey's deliberate refusals of what preview accepts (spec §5.6): a TextField min without inputType number, a Button action that is not {name, context?}, a TextField maxLength over guuey's bound, and a binding path that does not read.
